name: Ray-Octree Traversal with Stack-Based Backtracking
definition: A ray casting algorithm traversing an octree to find leaf voxels. It uses a stack to store parent context for backtracking when a ray exits a voxel or skips empty space, allowing it to resume traversal at a higher level.
summary: Ray-Octree Traversal with Stack-Based Backtracking is a ray casting algorithm that uses a stack to store parent context for backtracking when exiting voxels or skipping empty space.
